reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the finding correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant determination.

The cited grant language in p0022/p0024 affirmatively supports compliance: Client 'is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system... to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink', qualified only by TrueLink's IP and Section 10 confidentiality — i.e., no non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds Customer.

The sole 'Non-Competition Agreement' reference (p0054) is correctly characterised as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Client's Credit Data, i.e. a restraint operating against the counterparty, which the rule expressly permits; the rationale appropriately flags the separate agreement for independent diligence rather than overclaiming.

The 'ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables' language is a scope-of-grant limitation on use of TrueLink's own Interface, not a restraint on the businesses Customer may operate or the products it may buy or build, so it does not convert this into a deviation.
Deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes and the redline is byte-identical to the original, consistent with a no-edit compliant finding.
